task: PR147 — Rules, Discipline & Canonical Match Feedback

methodology.baseline: Untouched upstream PR146 archive 023fd3c9a217c4cde27479b356b4edf5fab2789d; node_modules junction only.
methodology.fixture: Existing performance harness, ten canonical minutes, seed pr146-performance:balanced:a, controlled central midfielder, fixed lineups, normal observers, batch20, profile1/37, explicit DEV choices.
methodology.load: Sequential after full verification; browser paused; no parallel tests or other heavy agent work.
methodology.rendering: Headless harness has no renderer. Its zero-renderer field is a contract, not a browser measurement. backgroundOrchestration.test.tsx spies actual UI render/capture and verifies hidden simulation makes no calls.
methodology.initialBaselineExcluded: Initial earlier baseline1 is exploratory, preserved below, excluded from the alternating comparison.

limitations: Rules, corrected orientation and throw-in lifecycle intentionally change the football trajectory and hashes between PR146 and PR147. Within-source repetitions and A/B/C observer modes must remain equal.

PR147 sample has 17 fouls, 13 yellows and five second-yellow dismissals in ten minutes, ending with nine home/eight away actors. Frequencies are uncalibrated and must be addressed in PR148 Discipline realism calibration; no arbitrary tuning was applied here.

Lower sample work is not evidence of an optimization: changed trajectory, fewer active actors, different human inputs and machine/JIT/GC variance affect timing. This bounded sample shows no material slowdown, not a full-match performance guarantee.
Single seed and three repetitions; no formal statistical trial, full 90-minute browser/playable duration, capture/video throughput or realistic disciplinary distribution claim.
Frozen PR146 reports lack the new defensive/discipline fields; missing is unavailable, not zero.
